subject: STOP statement
notes: kb/Work/PB411.md - LANDED, the twin of SR-14.9.18.3-6 and word for word the same rule ('Identifier-1 shall reference an integer data item or a data item with usage display or usage national'). ONE screen serves both verbs - ControlFlowBinder.BindTerminationStatus is the only decoder of the shared statusPhrase grammar rule, and CallBinder's GOBACK arm is its only other caller - so the alphanumeric-group defect and its fix are two-verb facts, measured on both: before, 'STOP RUN WITH ERROR STATUS <alphanumeric group>' drew COBOL1704 quoting this very rule; after, it compiles and passes the group's image to the operating system under the 14.9.42.4 GR5 determination published as docs/CONFORMANCE.md item 192. The usage answer comes from ItemCategory.UsageOf, the ONE 8.5.2.1 reader; 3.11's exclusions (bit, national, strongly-typed, variable-length) are each pinned - national ADMITTED by its 13.18.29.4 GR2 b usage, bit and strongly-typed REJECTED by negative fixtures. The index-name exclusion is 13.18.38.3 r7's, screened at the same site (COBOL1637). The phrase is a COBOL-2002 introduction on STOP, which is why the editions differ from the GOBACK twin's 2023.
